sources.title: Mistral Saba
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. The February 17, 2025 announcement explicitly reports 24B parameters. Its original benchmark figures, visually checked, distinguish Saba 24B Instruct from Saba 24B pretrain and compare them with Small 3 24B counterparts; their axes are accuracy or latency, not active parameters. The model is trained on Middle Eastern and South Asian data, supports Arabic and Indian languages including Tamil, and is offered through API or customer-premises deployment arranged with Mistral.

sources.title: Mistral Saba v25.02 model documentation
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Exact Saba v25.02 card describes a finetuned Small model, with Premier classification, mistral-saba-2502/latest aliases, 32k context and September 30, 2025 retirement. No separate Saba active count is displayed. The description alone does not name the Small version; the contemporaneous Groq launch statement supplies the 24B base identity. Page HTML modality tooltips explicitly specify Text input and Text output.

sources.evidence: Freshly fetched October 27, 2026. sources.title: OpenRouter Saba 2502 endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct HTTP JSON access succeeded. Mistral provider routes list 32,768 context tokens, 26,214 maximum completion tokens, tools/tool_choice parameters and explicit none/auto/required/function tool-choice support. File input is gateway metadata. Endpoint listing is not an inference request or proof of current operation.

sources.title: Magistral announcement

sources.title: PDF Inputs
sources.evidence: PDFs work with any OpenRouter model. For models without native file input, OpenRouter parses files and forwards the results; text-only models receive parsed text. Gateway file/PDF support does not establish native Saba multimodality.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference: Mistral describes Saba as a Small fine-tune; its contemporaneous Groq launch partner identifies the base as Mistral Small 24B. Mistral separately publishes 24B active for both Small 3/2501 base and instruct weights. The February 2025 partner statement predates Small 3.1; Saba is documented as 24B dense text, with no indicated pruning, expert expansion, distillation or added modality. Retain the base developer's nominal 24B active convention; this is not a direct Saba active-count disclosure or an equation of dense total with active.

architecture.note: Groq explicitly identifies the exact Saba model as a dense Transformer. No layer/configuration or sibling-architecture inference is used.

reasoning.note: No explicit exact-model reasoning or non-reasoning declaration was found. The retired Saba card has no reasoning classification; omission of reasoning controls from route metadata and the later Magistral first-reasoning-model announcement do not verify a Saba-specific false. Clear the baseline flag pending direct evidence.

patch.notes: Mistral publishes a nominal 24B total. Nominal 24B active is inferred from its documented Small fine-tune lineage, the Groq launch partner's identification of Small 24B as the base, and Mistral's separate 24B active specification for Small 3/2501; Saba has no direct active-count disclosure. Groq documents a dense Transformer. Mistral gives 32k context; 32,768 is the OpenRouter Mistral-route limit, with a separate 26,214 output cap. Native input/output are text; PDF handling is gateway preprocessing. Mistral retired Saba 25.02 on 2025-09-30; provider metadata does not establish current endpoint operation. Saba-specific reasoning-mode status remains unverified.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains the directly published nominal 24B total and establishes nominal 24B active through a labeled fine-tune lineage inference: Mistral's Saba description, Groq's contemporaneous named Small 24B base relationship, and Mistral's explicit Small 3/2501 active specification. No direct Saba active count or exact tensor census is claimed. The other 12 field assessments are preserved, including dense architecture, text-only modality, retirement context and unresolved reasoning status.

research_notes.search_scope: Reopened the original Saba announcement, current Saba card, pinned official Saba definition and Groq deployment page. Visually checked all three original announcement benchmark figures: they establish nominal Saba 24B identities but have no active-parameter axis. Searched exact Saba/active/activated parameter terms across Mistral, Groq, arXiv, ACL and general search for later model-research comparison tables. No explicit Saba active table was located. A separate named-base search found the firsthand February 27, 2025 Groq launch post; its Small 24B identity, Mistral's fine-tune description and explicit Small 3 active metadata support the recorded lineage inference.
research_notes.access_limitations: Web open of the OpenRouter JSON endpoint failed, but direct HTTPS access returned complete JSON. No paid inference request was made; route metadata and retirement status are recorded separately.
research_notes.variant: mistral-saba-2502 / mistral-saba-latest; not a later Small model or the distinct base/pretrain benchmark series.
research_notes.reasoning_followup: Searched Mistral Docs, official mistral-common documentation and mistralai GitHub for exact Saba/reasoning terms, then checked the 65 Python/Markdown files under docs/ and src/ in mistral-common main. No Saba-specific declaration was found. The later Magistral announcement and absent API reasoning controls are retained as search coverage, not proof of false.

parameter_reaudit.active: 24B is newly supported as a nominal lineage inference. The exact Saba developer description says finetuned Small; the contemporaneous Groq partnerships lead names Small 24B. January 2025 Small 3 is identified by the developer table and predates this February 2025 statement, unlike March 2025 Small 3.1. Both Small 3 base and instruct rows publish 24B active.
parameter_reaudit.limits: No source found with a direct Saba activated-parameter table. The inference preserves the base developer's counting convention, not exact every-token participation. No structural change is stated in the Saba or partner descriptions. No weight shards requested.
parameter_reaudit.fresh_access: Original Mistral announcement/card/source and Small 3 card/source fetched via HTTPS; original benchmark images visually inspected; Groq page and Loewenstein posts read in full through web. Direct Groq HTTPS returned 403; the web tool returned the readable page.
